form.heading: Send a general inquiry
form.intro: Use this form for a question about the company, a partnership or another general business matter. Please use the dedicated routes above for quotations, product documents or samples.

fields.label: Full Name (required)
fields.help: Enter the name we should use when replying.

fields.label: Business Email (required)
fields.help: We will use this address to reply to your inquiry.

fields.label: Country / Region (required)
fields.help: Enter the country or region where your company is based.

fields.label: Subject (required)
fields.help: Summarise your question in a few words.

fields.label: Message (required)
fields.help: Describe the general company or business matter you would like to discuss. Do not include passwords or payment details.

form.privacy: We will use the information you provide to review and respond to this inquiry. Read our Privacy Policy for more information about how personal data is handled.
form.privacyPrefix: We will use the information you provide to review and respond to this inquiry. Read our
form.privacySuffix: for more information about how personal data is handled.
form.process: After you submit, this page will show whether your inquiry was sent. If it cannot be sent, your entries will remain in place so you can try again.

summary.heading: Please check the form
summary.body: Review the highlighted fields and correct the items listed below.

errors.full_name_long: Keep your name to 100 characters or fewer.
errors.company_long: Keep your company name to 160 characters or fewer.
errors.business_email_invalid: Enter a valid email address, such as name@company.com.
errors.business_email_long: Keep your email address to 254 characters or fewer.
errors.country_region_long: Keep your country or region to 100 characters or fewer.
errors.subject_long: Keep the subject to 120 characters or fewer.
errors.message_long: Keep your message to 2,000 characters or fewer.

failure.heading: Your inquiry was not sent
failure.body: We could not send your inquiry. Your information has been kept in the form. Try again when you are ready.

success.heading: Your inquiry has been sent
success.body: Thank you. We have received your general inquiry for review.
